identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Atezolizumab in Combination With Cabozantinib Compared to Cabozantinib Alone in Participants With Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma After Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Treatment
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Multicenter, Randomized, Open-Label Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Atezolizumab Given in Combination With Cabozantinib Versus Cabozantinib Alone in Patients With Inoperable, Locally Advanced, or Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma Who Experienced Radiographic Tumor Progression During or After Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Treatment

armGroups.label: Atezo+Cabo
armGroups.description: Participants will receive atezolizumab every 3 weeks on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle (1 cycle=21 days) plus oral tablets of cabozantinib every day.

armGroups.label: Cabozantinib
armGroups.description: Participants will receive cabozantinib every day.

interventions.name: Atezolizumab
interventions.description: Atezolizumab 1200 mg will be administered at a fixed dose on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle by IV infusion every 3 weeks.

interventions.name: Cabozantinib
interventions.description: Cabozantinib 60 mg (three 20-mg tablets) administered orally once daily.
